notes.title: Seven Hearts: Free Transition and Compensation
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]First, we sincerely thank all of you who have cherished and supported Seven Hearts. Your trust and encouragement have been a great source of strength for us.[/p][p]After much deliberation and discussion, we have made a difficult decision to increase the number of players and provide a better gaming environment.[/p][p][b]Seven Hearts is now available for free to everyone.[/b][/p][p]To allow existing players to continue enjoying the game with more friends, and to enable new players to experience the game with them, we have decided to transition Seven Hearts to a free-to-play model.[/p][p][b]Free Transition Date: September 4, 2025[/b][/p][p][b]Compensation for Paying Customers[/b][/p][p]We sincerely thank and apologize to everyone who has purchased the game and supported us. In gratitude and with our apologies, we will provide [b]1,200 Diamonds[/b], equivalent to $12, to all existing paying customers on the free transition date.[/p][list][*][p]This compensation will not be provided to players who access the game after it becomes free.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you.[/p][p]Sincerely, The Seven Hearts Development Team[/p]
